name: statusline-band
description: A panel above the prompt with rate limits and their pace, context, cost and tokens, git status, and Clawd beside it

initials.title: Initials
initials.description: Up to two letters on Clawd's shirt; empty leaves it plain

cardColor.title: Card color
cardColor.description: Background of the band, as #rrggbb; empty for none, so it takes the terminal's own

padRows.title: Padding rows
padRows.description: Empty rows above and below the stats, 0 to 2

historyDays.title: History days
historyDays.description: Days the rolling cost total and the history pane cover, 7 to 62

noAttribution.title: No Claude credit in commits
noAttribution.description: Leave Co-Authored-By, Claude-Session and the Claude Code footer out of commits and pull requests

gitStrict.title: Strict git switches
gitStrict.description: On: with a switch on auto, only plain git commands naming their repo with -C run without a prompt; any other shape asks. Off: any git command runs without a prompt while the repo's switch is on auto

spotify.title: Spotify
spotify.description: While Spotify runs, show what it plays, with album art and controls, under the band (macOS)

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: Your Claude plan as the band shows it, such as Max 20x; empty reads it from Claude Code's own config
